metadata.description: Cursor plugins for agentic lifecycle, brain harness, Effect-TS awareness, and shared memory

plugins.name: umo-mr
plugins.description: UMO MR — org-default /mr command for creating GitLab merge requests: autodetects the default branch, always creates a new branch, conventional commits, preview, push, MR creation (glab preferred, GitLab MCP fallback), and optional JIRA sync.

plugins.name: umo-sdlc
plugins.description: UMO SDLC v1 — Markdown-first docs buckets, typed document lifecycles, service passports, service.catalog.json sidecars, and one compact docs skill with references/assets for setup, audit, and lifecycle.

plugins.name: umo-brain
plugins.description: DAVID brain harness — Brain MCP (david-brain) and brain-harness rule; organizational memory for agents

plugins.name: umo-effect
plugins.description: Effect-TS — always-on effect-awareness rule and effect-ts skill (guides + references) for idiomatic Effect.

plugins.name: umo-jira-tracker
plugins.description: UMO JIRA Tracker — links JIRA tickets to a local Beads database, automates sprint sync, drives commit/MR creation with STD-JIRA naming, and syncs outcomes back to JIRA.

plugins.name: umo-llm-wiki
plugins.description: LLM Wiki — read-only Atlassian MCP and llm-wiki-ask skill for querying the UMO process library (LLM-MIRROR) in Confluence.
